title: a valid build file under jitso/presets/ is not read: it is neither listed nor launchable
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D6 and the no-alias row (the catalog folder is jitso/builds/, the old folder is never read)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-10, build vocabulary; docs/decisions.md D6). The catalog is read from `jitso/builds/` only. The overlay adds `jitso/presets/legacy.yaml`, a valid approved build with the id `legacy` (a copy of haiku-explorer with a new id): `build list` does not list it and still lists the real builds, and `launch --build legacy --dry-run` exits 2 with `unknown build "legacy"` on stderr. The oracle reads `jitso/presets/` and nothing else: because the overlay creates that real folder, the ts adapter does not link `jitso/presets` to `jitso/builds`, so the oracle's catalog is the `legacy` file alone. It lists `legacy` and not the real builds, so the stdout expectations of the first step FAIL on TS (the second step is not reached).
